# feat(ml): add review intelligence and dynamic pricing

<!-- Generated by SessionEnd hook from a commit matching a journal-worthy pattern.

**Commit**: `5a8678abd8e2` — feat(ml): add review intelligence and dynamic pricing

**Body**:

Review Intelligence — rule-based NLP review analysis engine:
- Sentiment scoring (VADER-style lexicon matching with intensifiers)
- Traveler-type detection (solo, couple, family, group) via regex
- Topic extraction (food, culture, adventure, pace, safety, value, logistics)
- Improvement signal flagging for guide feedback
- N-gram extraction for common phrases
- Guide profile aggregation with sentiment trends and confidence

Dynamic Pricing — Grab/Uber-style demand-based pricing engine:
- Hourly surge multipliers (0.75–1.55x) based on time of day
- Day-of-week multipliers (0.95–1.35x)
- Thai holiday surcharges (up to 1.50x for Songkran/New Year)
- Seasonal peak multipliers (0.80–1.40x by month)
- Guide popularity adjustments (rating, experience, demand)
- Group size discounts (solo premium, large group discount)
- 15-minute price quote expiry with surge level classification

New endpoints:
- GET  /api/reviews/guide/{guide_id}/profile
- POST /api/reviews/batch/profile
- POST /api/pricing/quote
